therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: CD45RA+ T cell-depleted allogeneic peripheral blood stem cell transplant
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: selective depletion of naive T cells while preserving memory T cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: prevention of graft-versus-host disease while maintaining graft-versus-leukemia effect
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: children with hematologic malignancies requiring allogeneic stem cell transplant
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: graft failure and time to discontinuation of systemic immunosuppression

results.effect_size: graft failure: 1/20 patients (5%); median time to discontinuation of prednisone: 106 days (95% CI: 87-238); median time to discontinuation of all immunosuppression: 349 days (95% CI: 266-405)
safety_signals: no chronic GVHD requiring systemic immunosuppression
